modules.description: Introduces vectors as quantities with magnitude and direction, and demonstrates real-time updates of these values as a vector is manipulated.
modules.author: A Robot
educationalObjectives: Manipulate a vector in 3D space and observe real-time updates of its properties.
instructions: Observe the vector. Its tail is fixed at the origin, and its head indicates the direction and magnitude.
Try grabbing the head of the vector and dragging it around in 3D space. Notice how the magnitude and direction labels update in real-time.

clips.changeMeaning: Spawn a single vector with its tail at the origin and head extended. Display magnitude and direction labels.
clips.narration: Vectors are fundamental in physics. They represent quantities that have both a size, called magnitude, and a direction in space. Unlike scalars, which only have magnitude, vectors need both. This arrow represents a vector. You can see its tail at the origin and its head pointing outward. Labels show its current magnitude and direction.
